sql: SELECT c.date AS ds, SUM(s.sales) AS y FROM m5_sales_train s JOIN m5_calendar c ON s.d = c.d WHERE s.item_id = 'FOODS_1_215' GROUP BY c.date ORDER BY c.date ASC
sql_explanation: Retrieves the daily sales trend (y) for the specified product (FOODS_1_215) using the real calendar date (ds) as the time index.
